# peekdb

> Enforced read-only CLI and MCP server for Postgres, MongoDB, and Redis.
> Agents and humans can explore data; writes are blocked by construction.

Website: https://harkirat155.github.io/peekdb/
Repository: https://github.com/Harkirat155/peekdb
License: MIT

## What it is

peekdb is a single Rust binary that:
1. Runs as an MCP server over stdio for Claude Code, Cursor, Grok, and other MCP clients
2. Runs as a CLI (`query` / `mongo` / `redis` / `repl` / `explore` / `doctor` / `audit` / `fav`)
3. Enforces multi-layer read-only access (allowlists, Postgres READ ONLY transactions, nested Mongo $out/$merge block, Redis command allowlist)
4. Audits every call to append-only JSONL

## Install (for agents)

```bash
cargo install --git https://github.com/Harkirat155/peekdb
# or download a release binary from https://github.com/Harkirat155/peekdb/releases
peekdb init
# edit ~/.config/peekdb/databases.toml — use ${ENV_VAR} for passwords
peekdb doctor
peekdb mcp-snippet   # paste into MCP client config
```

Config discovery order: `--config` → `$PEEKDB_CONFIG` → `./databases.toml` → `~/.config/peekdb/databases.toml`

## MCP config (Claude / Cursor)

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "peekdb": {
      "command": "/absolute/path/to/peekdb",
      "args": ["--config", "/absolute/path/to/databases.toml"],
      "env": {
        "STAGING_DB_PASSWORD": "...",
        "RUST_LOG": "warn"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Or run with no args when `DATABASE_URL` is set (defaults to `serve`).

## MCP tools (call in this order)

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `list_targets` | Names + backend (postgres/mongo/redis). Call first. |
| `list_objects` | Tables / collections / Redis SCAN for a target |
| `describe_object` | Columns/indexes (PG), fields+indexes (Mongo), TYPE/TTL (Redis) |
| `sample_object` | Sample rows/docs (PG/Mongo) |
| `sql_query` | Read-only SQL (SELECT/WITH/EXPLAIN/SHOW/VALUES/TABLE). Default result: JSON. |
| `mongo_query` | find/aggregate/distinct/count/list_*. $out/$merge blocked at any depth. |
| `redis_query` | Allowlisted read commands only |

Optional: `format: "table"` on query tools for ASCII tables.

## MCP resources

- `peekdb://{target}/schema` — tables/collections snapshot
- `peekdb://{target}/tables/{name}` or `…/collections/{name}` — object detail

## Optional safety (databases.toml per target)

```toml
allow_tables = ["users", "orders"]
max_calls_per_minute = 60
max_rows_per_minute = 5000
max_response_bytes = 1048576
redact_columns = ["email", "ssn"]
redact_patterns = ["*password*"]
```

## Human CLI cheatsheet

```bash
peekdb query --db staging --sql "SELECT 1" --format json
peekdb repl --db staging          # \dt \d \sample \fav \format
peekdb explore --db staging       # interactive table browser
peekdb audit --blocked
peekdb fav save daily --sql "SELECT now()"
```

## Security guarantees (short)

- No write mode / no --write flag
- Postgres: statement allowlist + single-statement + session RO + transaction RO
- Mongo: op allowlist + recursive $out/$merge block (incl. $facet/$lookup)
- Redis: deny-by-default command allowlist
- Audit log never stores connection strings
- Literal passwords in config rejected unless allow_literal_password = true
